tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The full-colour logo sits on the light value; the reversed logo on the dark value.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table headers and alternate page bands on surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet red-tinted relief for a highlighted band or callout. Never behind the logo.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and eyebrow labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint. The light value is the logo grey.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; it does not meet 3:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines on surface and surface-raised (at least 3:1).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The logo grey, sampled from the wordmark and shield. Large fills and graphic blocks; carries on-graphite text. On the dark surface it is a low-contrast shape, so never use it for text or meaningful marks there.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on graphite (7:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The lit facet of the logo gem. Graphic accents, large shapes and the single point of emphasis on a page. Not a text colour and not a ground for body-size text (white on it is 3.8:1; fine at 24px and up).

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: The shaded facet of the logo gem. Primary button and badge fill; carries on-red text at any size.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red-deep (6.2:1), and on red at 24px and up only.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Links, inline emphasis and the focus ring on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, tracked wide like the wordmark. Set the text in capitals.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy. Keep lines near 65 characters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its section body; block gap inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Bands, cards, images and graphic blocks are square, like the cut edges of the mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and tooltips only.
